items.name: Celestial Light
items.bonus_5: Upon using Intro Skill, Spectro DMG increases by 30% for 15s.

items.name: Chromatic Foam
items.bonus_5: When the Resonator inflicts Fusion Burst on the enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting an Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s.

items.name: Crown of Valor
items.bonus_3: Upon gaining a Shield, increase the Resonator's ATK by 6% and Crit. DMG by 4% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s and stacks up to 5 times.

items.name: Dream of the Lost
items.bonus_3: Holding 0 Resonance Energy increases Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

items.name: Empyrean Anthem
items.bonus_5: Increase the Resonator's Coordinated Attack DMG by 80%. Upon a critical hit of Coordinated Attack, increase the active Resonator's ATK by 20% for 4s.

items.name: Endless Resonance
items.bonus_5: While on the field, ATK increases by 5% every 1.5s, stacking up to 4 times. Outro Skill DMG increases by 60%.

items.name: Eternal Radiance
items.bonus_5: Inflicting enemies with Spectro Frazzle increases Crit. Rate by 20% for 15s. Attacking enemies with 10 stacks of Spectro Frazzle grants 15% Spectro DMG Bonus for 15s.

items.name: Flamewing's Shadow
items.bonus_3: Dealing Echo Skill DMG increases Heavy Attack Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. Dealing Heavy Attack DMG increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. While both effects are active, gain 16% Fusion DMG Bonus.

items.name: Flaming Clawprint
items.bonus_5: Casting Resonance Liberation grants all Resonators in the team 15% Fusion DMG Bonus and the caster 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus, lasting for 35s.

items.name: Flash of Electric Reflection
items.bonus_5: When the Resonator inflicts Electro Flare on enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s.

items.name: Flower of Tinged Yearning
items.bonus_5: Healing a Resonator in the team increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 10% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked. While the effect is active, if the Resonator gains Unison or triggers Unison Response, their ATK is further increased by 15%.

items.name: Freezing Frost
items.bonus_5: Upon using Basic Attack or Heavy Attack, Glacio DMG increases by 10%, stacking up to three times, lasting for 15s.

items.name: Frosty Resolve
items.bonus_5: Casting Resonance Skill grants 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus for 15s and casting Resonance Liberation increases Resonance Skill DMG by 18%, lasting for 5s. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

items.name: Gusts of Welkin
items.bonus_5: Inflicting Aero Erosion upon enemies increases Aero DMG for all Resonators in the team by 15%, and for the Resonator triggering this effect by an additional 15%, lasting for 20s.

items.name: Halo of Starry Radiance
items.bonus_5: When healing a Resonator in the team, every 1% of Off-Tune Buildup Rate grants a 0.2% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team for 4s, up to 25%. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

items.name: Havoc Eclipse
items.bonus_5: Upon using Basic Attack or Heavy Attack, Havoc DMG increases by 7.5%, stacking up to four times for 15s.

items.name: Heart of Evil's Purge
items.bonus_5: Inflicting Tune Strain - Shifting increases Crit. DMG by 20% and Aero DMG Bonus 30% for 15s.

items.name: Heart of Sworn Vigil
items.bonus_5: Inflicting Electro Flare on the target, obtaining Unison, or triggering Unison Response increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 15% and grants them 22.5% Electro DMG for 30s.

items.name: Lamp of Nether Road
items.bonus_5: Upon gaining a Shield, gain 5% increase in Crit. Rate for 5s, max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered every 0.5s. At max stacks, gain 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.

items.name: Law of Harmony
items.bonus_3: Casting Echo Skill grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the caster for 4s. Additionally, all Resonators in the team gain 4% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. Echoes of the same name can only trigger this effect once. The record of Echo triggering this effect is cleared along with this effect. At 4 stacks, casting Echo Skill again resets the duration of this effect.

items.name: Midnight Veil
items.bonus_5: When Outro Skill is triggered, deal additional 480% Havoc DMG to surrounding enemies, considered Outro Skill DMG, and grant the incoming Resonator 15% Havoc DMG Bonus for 15s.

items.name: Molten Rift
items.bonus_5: Upon using Resonance Skill, Fusion DMG increases by 30% for 15s.

items.name: Moonlit Clouds
items.bonus_5: Upon using Outro Skill, ATK of the next Resonator increases by 22.5% for 15s.

items.name: Pact of Neonlight Leap
items.bonus_5: Casting Outro Skill increases the ATK of the incoming Resonator by 15%, with each point of Tune Break Boost additionally increasing ATK by 0.3%, up to 15%. This effect lasts for 15s, or until the Resonator is switched out.

items.name: Reel of Spliced Memories
items.bonus_5: Inflicting Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on enemies increases the Tune Break Boost of Resonators in the team by 20 for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.

items.name: Rejuvenating Glow
items.bonus_5: Upon healing allies, increase ATK of the entire team by 15%, lasting 30s.

items.name: Rite of Gilded Revelation
items.bonus_5: Dealing Basic Attack DMG increases Spectro DMG by 10% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 stacks, casting Resonance Liberation grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

items.name: Shadow of Shattered Dreams
items.bonus_2: Inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target grants 35% Basic Attack DMG Bonus and Heavy Attack DMG Bonus for 15s.

items.name: Sierra Gale
items.bonus_5: Upon using Intro Skill, Aero DMG increases by 30% for 15s.

items.name: Song of Feathered Trace
items.bonus_5:
Upon inflicting Havoc Bane, gain Xuanling's Feather, which grants a 20% increase in Crit. Rate and 35% increase in Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the Resonator, lasting 15s.

Upon inflicting Glacio Chafe, gain Chongming's Feather, which grants a 0.1% increase in ATK to Resonators in the team for every 1% of the Resonator's Energy Regen, up to 25%, lasting 10s.

items.name: Sound of True Name
items.bonus_5: Dealing Echo Skill DMG to enemies increases the Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20%, and grants 15% Aero DMG Bonus for 5s.

items.name: Thread of Severed Fate
items.bonus_3: Inflicting Havoc Bane increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% and grants 30% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 5s.

items.name: Tidebreaking Courage
items.bonus_5: Increase the Resonator's ATK by 15%. Reaching 250% Energy Regen increases all Attribute DMG by 30% for the Resonator.

items.name: Trailblazing Star
items.bonus_5: Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 20% Fusion DMG Bonus for 8s.

items.name: Void Thunder
items.bonus_5: Upon using Heavy Attack or Resonance Skill, Electro DMG increases by 15%, stacking up to 2 times, each stack lasting for 15s.

items.name: Windward Pilgrimage
items.bonus_5: Hitting a target with Aero Erosion increases Crit. Rate by 10% and grants 30% Aero DMG Bonus, lasting for 10s.

items.name: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall
items.bonus_5: Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect for 15s, which can be triggered once every 25s. While Snowfall is active: Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. While the effect is active, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG extends its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times. Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants 25% Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for 15s. When Snowfall is removed, only one of the effects above can be triggered.
